content.title: Papa John's, Navitas, Critical Metals: Trending Stocks
content.description:
Rare-earth stocks rally as tensions between the US and China rise again, with MP Materials (MP) and Critical Metals (CRML) posting big gains in pre-market. Papa John's (PZZA) keep rising on speculation surrounding a takeover bid. And in the world of tech and AI, while Navitas (NVTS) is skyrocketing following positive updates about its collaboration with Nvidia (NVDA), many other big names seem set to open in the red: notably Intel (INTC), TSMC (TSM), Alphabet (GOOG) and Broadcom (AVGO).

For more live coverage of markets watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and head to Yahoo Finance.

content.title: Navitas Stock Soars. How It’s Getting an Nvidia Boost.
content.summary: Navitas Semiconductor  stock was surging higher shortly after the opening bell Tuesday after the company said it was making progress on new power chips to support artificial-intelligence infrastructure designed by  Nvidia  announced in May.  “As Nvidia drives transformation in AI infrastructure, we’re proud to support this shift with advanced GaN and SiC power solutions that enable the efficiency, scalability, and reliability required by next-generation data centers,” said CEO Chris Allexandre in a statement late Monday.  Navitas stock surged 17% to $11.63 early Tuesday, after having risen as much as 30% in the premarket.
